source: MAFF Department of Agricultural Extension / ASPIRE Project (IFAD-funded) - "Climate Resilient Banana Growing Technique" (ផលិតកម្មដំណាំចេកដែលធន់ទៅនឹងការប្រែប្រួលអាកាសធាតុ), November 2018
text:
The booklet gives a concrete fertilizer schedule: a mixed application of urea and DAP (diammonium phosphate) fertilizer is applied at a rate of about 45 grams per plant, split across four applications per year, placed in a ring around the plant roughly 50 centimeters from the base rather than touching the stem directly, to avoid fertilizer burn while still reaching the active root zone.

Regular, split applications through the growing season are emphasized over one large dose, matching fertilizer supply to banana's sustained vegetative growth and the heavy nutrient draw of bunch filling later in the cycle.
